description: Use when an agent has to pick a chain that is actually answering before it commits to one: every supported chain in a single call, each with its chain id, block height, how many seconds stale its head is, and ok. Do not use for one chain on its own (/v1/evm/block) or for what a transaction will cost there (/v1/evm/gas, and /v1/evm/fees for EIP-1559 caps). No API key, no account. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

chain.description: Optional: check just one. base | ethereum | polygon | arbitrum | optimism. All of them when omitted.
